claims.claim: "No Place to Hide" finds $346M+ net attacker profit and 28M+ sandwich attacks against protected order flow across 6 chains, Jul 2023-Jun 2026
Solana: 28,042,725 sandwiches by 8,631 entities, $383.4M gross / $345.2M net profit
Ethereum: 30,607 sandwiches by 7 bots, $622,358 gross / $254,566 net; top 2 bots = 78.0% of attacks; all 7 bots likely one entity
Tron: 38,567 sandwiches by 12 bots (4 entities), $901,069 gross / $642,542 net; 2 bots = 77.0% of attacks; 9 of 12 bots share one funding wallet
Base: 1,889 sandwiches by 4 bots (3 groups), $3,031 gross / $2,416 net
Arbitrum and Monad show zero persistent sandwich attackers under the paper's H1/H2/H3 methodology
Ethereum protected sandwiches have median 58 transactions between front leg and victim, 131 between victim and back leg, vs ~1 for public-mempool sandwiches

66.8% of attributed Ethereum victims appear in at least one OFA hint dataset; 70.4% appear jointly in MEV-Share and MEVBlocker ("double-hashing" correlation); 62.2% appear in the Blink whitelisted-searcher dataset
9,297 reorged Ethereum blocks exposed 56,730 previously-private swaps; 2,875 were subsequently sandwiched; only 65.9% of stale block bodies were recovered
Axiom sets jitodontfront on 98.5% of its 21.5M sandwiched Solana victim transactions, but only 16.5% of those sandwiches carried a Jito tip
Jito suspended its Block Engine mempool ("MempoolStream") on 2024-03-08, citing sandwich-attack risk it could not otherwise engineer around
Marinade DAO's MIP.9 (2025-02-07) blocklisted 73 validators (~1.27M SOL, ~15.3% of relevant stake) from its Stake Auction Marketplace for repeated sandwiching
Post-intervention on Solana, elevated-leader exposure share fell to ~2%, but ~20,000 sandwiches/day persist, 96% now cross-block

Tron's official documentation describes FCFS/FIFO mempool ordering with no reference to front-running or MEV; the 98% front-running-prevention figure traces only to an informal Justin Sun statement, not to Tron's own docs
Base op-geth PR #118 (2023-08-22, disables pending-tx filters/subscriptions) was reverted on 2023-09-01; PR #122 (2023-08-23) separately disabled the local txpool for sequencer-fronting RPC nodes
A separate 2024 academic study (arXiv:2405.00138) independently found no sandwiching activity on popular rollups, attributing it to the absence of a public pending-tx mempool
Monad mainnet launched 2025-11-24, giving the paper's study under one year of Monad data vs. Solana's history since March 2020
Author affiliations: Heimbach (Category Labs, which builds Monad), Solmaz (ETH Zurich), Öz (Flashbots, operates MEV-Share), Torres (INESC-ID/IST Lisbon)
The paper is an arXiv-only preprint as of research date, with no conference/journal acceptance found, and a companion GitHub repo with a single commit and zero stars/forks

"Sandwiched and Silent" (arXiv:2512.17602) independently found 2,932 private Ethereum sandwich attacks in Nov-Dec 2024, $293,785.95 attacker profit, using a different, looser detection heuristic than the 2026 paper
Flashbots reports private mempools carry roughly half of all Ethereum gas, a share that has nearly doubled since early 2024

SEC found Robinhood violated best-execution duty via PFOF, quantifying $34.1M customer harm and imposing a $65M penalty (2020-12-17); SEC's 2022 order-competition-rule proposal to reform PFOF was withdrawn 2025-06-12 without being finalized

Estimated Solana sandwich-profit-to-DEX-volume ratio is ~1.2-1.4 bps (2024-25); Ethereum's ratio is ~0.004 bps (2024) — a ~25-370x gap; both figures are this article's own approximate synthesis from secondary volume estimates, not the paper's own stated ratio
Flashbots' SUAVE client repository (suave-geth) was archived (made read-only) on 2025-05-12, years after being pitched as removing centralized actors from block-building
